description: List all indexed knowledge bases with metadata. Optionally filter to active only.
embedding_description: List every installed knowledge base together with its metadata: name, source type, chunk count, and active or inactive status. A read-only enumeration that changes nothing; the active_only flag narrows results to the knowledge bases currently included in search. Use to inventory which knowledge bases exist, check whether a given one is installed, or see which are active.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: List of installed knowledge bases with metadata
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Present as a formatted list with name, status, and chunk count.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.
